lines.t: The clouds roll back, the veil is torn
The lion rises fierce and bold
The earth stands still beneath his flame
For every knee will bow to his name
His voice commands the winds of night
His glory blinds the strongest light
With righteousness His robe is sealed
His hidden mysteries revealed
The mountains crack before His face
The nations crumble in His face
He shakes the heavens with a word
The King of Truth, the only Lord
Yahushua, Stormbreaker of Zion
Righteous Judge, we rely on
Thunderfalls in your decree
Chains dissolve and captives flee
Yahushua, Fire on the throne
Claiming every soul you own
All creation bows before the mighty King, forevermore
He stands where ancient prophets saw The living word, the final law
His eyes like coals, His presence strong The shepherd calling every child
The wicked flee from his burning gaze
The humble rise in newborn blaze
For mercy flows from his hand
And his truth restores the broken land
Yahushua
Stormbreaker of Zion, righteous judge
We rely on thunderfalls of your decree
Chains dissolve and captives bleed
Whose you are, fire on the throne, claiming every soul you own
All creation bows before the mighty King forevermore
The skies ignite, the angels shout
His name, the flame that drives fear out
His kingdom comes, His justice stands
The whole world held in nail-scarred hands
Holy
Yahushua
Breaker of the storm
The King forevermore
Yahushua
Stormbreaker of Zion
Holy judge, we rely on
Thunderfalls of your decree
Chains dissolve and captives flee
Fire on the throne
Claiming every soul you own
Every kingdom great and small
Falls before the Lord of all
His light will swallow every fear
His voice, the song, the nations hear
The storm will end, the night will cease
For Yahushua is the Prince of Peace
